items.content_html: This project focuses on developing a Unitree Go2 robot as a platform for environmental monitoring. Specifically, we conduct inference with DINOv3 vision encoder on a NVIDIA Jetson embedded device. A core feature of this project is the ability to precisely geotag captured images by synchronizing them with RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) GPS data.
